title: XYBench: Can LLMs Respond Pragmatically to Queries with Misconceptions?
abstract: arXiv:2609.06842v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: When non-expert users ask LLMs for assistance, their queries can often have misconceptions (e.g., "How do I parse XML with regex?"). In such cases, often referred to as the XY-problem, LLMs must identify the misconception ("regex are fragile") and meaningfully direct the user toward a pragmatic solution that will address the root problem implicit in the request ("use an XML parser"). We introduce XYBench, a benchmark of 8,115 such queries, drawn from technical (StackOverflow/StackExchange) and everyday (WikiHow and a manually-curated subset) domains. We design an evaluation paradigm that assesses model responses along three criteria grounded in cooperative response theory: (a) presence and (b) emphasis on pragmatic solutions, and (c) identification of misconceptions. translated_title: XYBench：大语言模型能否务实地回应带有误解的查询？
translated_abstract: 当非专业用户向大语言模型（LLM）寻求帮助时，他们的查询中往往包含误解（例如，“如何用正则表达式解析XML？”）。在这种情况下，通常被称为XY问题，LLM必须识别出误解（“正则表达式很脆弱”），并有效地引导用户走向能够解决请求中隐含的根本问题的务实解决方案（“使用XML解析器”）。我们提出了XYBench，这是一个包含8,115个此类查询的基准，这些查询来自技术领域和非日常生活领域（StackOverflow/StackExchange）以及日常领域（WikiHow和一个人工筛选的子集）。我们设计了一个基于合作回应理论的评估范式，从三个标准评估模型响应： 务实解决方案的存在性， 对务实解决方案的强调程度，以及 对误解的识别。我们的实验表明，即使是最强大的LLM也主要回答字面上的请求（0.75--0.92），而很少回答用户真正意图的请求（0.33--0.71），同时存在显著……
tldr: 本文提出了包含8,115个带误解查询的XYBench基准，并从务实解决方案的存在性、强调程度和误解识别三个维度评估发现，即使最强的LLM也主要回答字面问题而非用户隐含的根本问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces XYBench, a benchmark of 8,115 queries containing misconceptions, and evaluates LLM responses on pragmatic solution presence, emphasis, and misconception identification, finding that even the strongest LLMs predominantly answer the literal request rather than the intended underlying problem.
